response.justification: Strong, versatile engineer with 13+ years of hands-on experience, a CS degree, polyglot depth (TypeScript/Node, D, C/C++, Java), and credible high-throughput work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby. However, the resume shows essentially no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation platforms, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or growth measurement. Scope has also remained largely at senior/staff IC level within small-to-mid companies rather than the multi-team, cross-org, enterprise-scale architectural leadership expected at Principal/IC6. Possible bench-strength candidate for a senior backend/platform role, but a stretch for this specific Principal Growth/Experimentation position.
strengths: 13+ years across web, backend, embedded; solid CS fundamentals and TDD/CI craftsmanship
Low-latency, high-volume microservices experience (millions of HTTP req/s at Sociomantic)
Broad language coverage (C/C++, Java, C#, JS/TS) plus AI-agent/MCP tooling exposure
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, or rollout-risk/bias-detection experience
No telemetry, metrics platform, or statistical/data-analysis track record
Scope and influence below Principal/IC6: little evidence of multi-team, org-wide initiatives

key_factors.factor: Principal-level scope and cross-team technical leadership
Engineering breadth and high-scale distributed systems background
